title: FR: Continue Snooze function/button
body:
When I charge my smartphone I set snooze to 2 hours. But sometimes (let's say when charge transmitter or something else) I need to continue snooze. Is it possible to make Continue Snooze button when "Disable All Alerts" mode is activated? Because by default you have only Re-Enable All Alerts. It will be very nice to have "roll" (to select time) with Continue Snooze button like when you deal with usual hypo/hyper snooze function.

>Is it possible to make Continue Snooze button when "Disable All Alerts" mode is activated?

If you have disabled all alerts, what would be the point of continue to snooze?
If alerts are disabled, they will never ring.  What is there to snooze?
